acceptance_predicates.description: The lockfile resolves rustls at or above 0.23.46 and removes the reported RUSTSEC advisories without a waiver.
Locked/offline tests, Clippy, coverage, policy, and supply-chain checks pass with existing thresholds and gates.
Signed DCO exact-head review, hosted CI, merge, and post-merge verification agree, or a precise compatibility blocker is recorded.

definition_of_done: Only the required Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock change in the product diff.
All applicable non-formal quality and supply-chain gates pass without weakening policy.
The reviewed PR merges green and durable coordination evidence closes the AR, or the exact blocker leaves it open/blocked.

inputs.description: Hosted PR #635 failure showing rustls 0.23.45 and advisories RUSTSEC-2026-0347, RUSTSEC-2026-0348, and RUSTSEC-2026-0349.

outputs.description: Minimal reviewed Cargo manifest and lockfile update.
Bounded local and hosted non-formal policy, test, coverage, and supply-chain evidence.
Signed PR, exact-head CI, merge, post-merge, and AR lifecycle evidence or precise blocker.

gates.description: Existing dependency policy and advisory checks pass without waivers.
Locked/offline tests, Clippy, and coverage checks pass at existing floors.
Signed DCO exact-head hosted review, green CI, merge, and post-merge verification pass.
